entities.summary: "Mila" is a song by Serbian singer Princ. The song was released on 27 January 2025 by PGP-RTS and was written by Dušan Bačić. It represented Serbia at the Eurovision Song Contest 2025. It also serves as the title track for his debut studio album Mila.
